children: Finland blood test provider's annual revenue grew 17% yr/yr
Annual net loss and loss per share remained unchanged from prior year
Company expanded commercial operations, secured new contracts and received clinical lab permit in New York
Nightingale Health targets revenue of at least EUR 10 mln for FY 2026–2027
Company will continue investing in international commercial operations in healthcare and research markets
Company does not expect to distribute a dividend in the short or medium term
PROJECT DELAY - Co said revenue growth was limited by postponement of EUR 2.4 mln Denmark cohort study project, deferring about EUR 2 mln in revenue to next yr
SALES INVESTMENTS - Co said increased sales investments and expansion of commercial team contributed to revenue growth
NEW CONTRACTS - Co secured new agreements and launched pilot projects, helping drive customer interest and sales pipeline growth
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the biotechnology & medical research peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Nightingale Health Oyj is €1.40, about 48% above its September 15 closing price of €0.95
